prerequisites: Basic knowledge about mechanics and production engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Explain fundamental operating principles and functions of machine elements.
Understand which requirements and selection criteria influence the choice of suitable machine elements.
Classify typical application scenarios and industrial examples.
Identify the theoretical foundations of common calculation approaches.
Know the essential standards, rules and representation forms of technical drawing for individual parts and assemblies including principles of dimensioning, tolerancing and bill of materials.
Perform design calculations for the covered machine elements based on current state-of-the-art method.
Transfer the knowledge acquired in the module to new requirements and engineering tasks and derive appropriate design solutions.
Understand and correctly interpret technical drawings and principle sketches.
Evaluate simple designs, derive purposeful improvements and justify decisions on a technical basis.

Exchange ideas about technical content within the framework of activating teaching formats, address questions, provide feedback, and contribute different perspectives in an appreciative manner. Develop an initial understanding of cooperative working methods in engineering contexts and the importance of clear communication for a common technical understanding.

Independently deepen the knowledge acquired in exercises, use textbooks and relevant standards to further develop calculation methods and reflect on their own approach. Build the ability to address engineering tasks responsibly and continuously enhance their own capability to act.

assessment_rules: The examination is a written exam of 120 minutes duration. A compulsory written elaboration "Konstruktionsprojekt 1" is required for course achievement.
